highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.152.0 adds Graphite GPU bindings, asynchronous pixel reads, and the Skia m152 engine update.
highlights_body: This release also fixes native lifetime bugs, adds Vulkan Silk.NET support, and improves Android, Apple, Windows, and containerized deployment.

bullets.detail: Updates the bundled renderer through the m152 servicing and GlyphData fixes.

bullets.lead: Graphite and asynchronous pixel read APIs
bullets.detail: Adds Graphite GPU backend bindings for Vulkan, Metal, and Dawn, plus backend-neutral asynchronous RequestReadPixels APIs on images and surfaces.
The Vulkan Silk.NET integration package is available again for supported Vulkan applications.
Fixes use-after-free and leak paths in SKRegion iteration, SKPixmap subsets, SKImage raster creation, and stream conversion to HarfBuzz blobs.

bullets.lead: Runtime effect and text APIs avoid unnecessary work
bullets.detail: Disposes replaced uniform buffers and reduces allocations in data saving, encoded text retrieval, tags, and HarfBuzz shaping.

bullets.lead: Native diagnostics and deployment support improved
bullets.detail: Apple symbol packages are generated during packing, Android symbol identity is deterministic, Nano Server uses FreeType, and Windows native builds initialize MSVC once.

contributor_summaries.jeffska: FreeType support for Nano Server font rendering

preview_summaries.v4.152.0-rc.1.26426.14: Release Candidate 1 finalized symbol packages, Vulkan support, lifetime fixes, and the m152 servicing update.
preview_summaries.v4.152.0-preview.1.1: Preview 1 introduced Graphite bindings, asynchronous pixel reads, and the Skia m152 engine update.

harfbuzz_summary: Improves HarfBuzzSharp stream ownership, shaping input performance, and tag formatting.
